title: Yellowed Crisp Polish Porcini Dumplings
description: A cozy Polish dish featuring fermented porcini mushrooms, with a crisp exterior and a sweet surprise from candy, all made paleo-friendly. This dish is perfect for a cold winter evening.
instructions: In a large bowl, combine the almond flour, coconut sugar, and salt.
In a separate bowl, whisk together the eggs and coconut oil.
Add the fermented porcini mushrooms to the egg mixture and stir until well combined.
Gradually add the dry ingredients to the egg mixture and mix until a dough forms.
Knead the dough for 5 minutes until it becomes smooth and elastic.
Divide the dough into 8 equal pieces and shape each piece into a ball.
Flatten each ball into a disk shape and place a small piece of candy in the center of each disk.
Fold the dough over the candy and press the edges together to seal the dumpling.
Heat a large skillet over medium heat and add a small amount of coconut oil.
Cook the dumplings for 3-4 minutes on each side, until they are golden brown and crispy.
